# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid, beautiful young woman with black eyes. She carried off the palm for beauty in the Second Year classes at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella has a heartful of aerial and rainbow-like dreams and fancies. She is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious, though she can occasionally be pessimistic or critical of others' actions. She has a habit of throwing each sheet of manuscript onto the floor as she writes.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014)_

## Traits

- thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

- Writing papers and compositions  <sub>[v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy, where she formed a close circle of friends with Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant. After graduating from Queen's, she taught school for some time before deciding to attend Redmond College. She came up with the idea to rent Patty's Place in Kingsport for their second year at Redmond, inviting her Aunt Jamesina to keep house for them and living alongside Anne, Priscilla, and Philippa Gordon. Stella continued her studies at Redmond, participating in campus activities like the Philomathic Society, and successfully passed her final examinations alongside her housemates.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c16 P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004), [v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
